comment: DACs confirmed to decode DoP, and makers known for DSD DACs. Every entry needs an https source saying where the claim comes from. Matching never uses the unit serial. See docs/DOP-AUTO-SETUP.md.

dacs.name: FiiO K11
dacs.source: https://github.com/szeremeta1/Vespertine/blob/main/docs/DEVICES.md (DSD to DSD128 played over DoP on a K11; the old allow list entry); FiiO's own spec page https://www.fiio.com/k11_parameters lists DSD256 over USB
dacs.note: Was in DoPDefaults.knownDoPPrefixes before this list existed.

dacs.name: Fosi Audio ZD3
dacs.source: https://github.com/szeremeta1/Vespertine/blob/main/docs/DEVICES.md (owner played DSD to DSD256 over DoP on a ZD3 on 2026-10-28; USB ID 152a:889b and the Core Audio rates are recorded there)
dacs.note: Was in DoPDefaults.knownDoPPrefixes before this list existed. DSD512 would need a 1411.2 kHz carrier macOS can't carry.

dacs.name: iBasso DC07 Pro
dacs.source: https://github.com/szeremeta1/Vespertine/issues/247 (the owner of a DC07 Pro reports DSD64 played as PCM until DoP was switched on, then natively, and gives the Core Audio UID); USB ID 2fc6:f0b7 from https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/sound/usb/quirks.c (DEVICE_FLG 0x2fc6, 0xf0b7, "iBasso DC07 Pro")
dacs.note: iBasso's own pages list DSD but do not use the word DoP; the evidence is the report.
